symptom: token-signer keeps restarting, but its logs show no error: it says the signer daemon started.
root_cause: The container's shell script starts the signer daemon in the background (sleep 3600 &) and then reaches its end, so the main process exits with code 0 (Completed). With restartPolicy Always the kubelet restarts it again and again (CrashLoopBackOff), although nothing fails.
